projects.title: Communication optimization for High Performance IO staging in Distributed and SuperComputing systems
projects.description:
- Studied IO staging, an augmented IO for High Performance Storage Systems.
- Designed and implemented message pipelining, and parallel message transferring to
accelerate data movement.
- Designed and implemented a predictive runtime scheduling to prevent communication perturbation.
- Attained the upperbound bandwidth limit for IO staging systems.

projects.title: High Performance Computation for image segmentation in Distributed systems
projects.description:
- Studied the image segmentation algorithm in the Nature paper of Sharon.
- Designed and implemented an optimal parallel algorithm for this problem on multicore systems
- Got the 80%*N speedup on N-cores systems.
